description: This file defines a jQuery plugin for a calendar widget called Zabuto Calendar, including default settings, language options, and functions for rendering and managing calendar display, events, and modals.

methods.name: $.fn.zabuto_calendar
methods.description: Main function to initialize and render the calendar widget on selected elements.

methods.name: $.fn.zabuto_calendar_defaults
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the calendar.

methods.name: $.fn.zabuto_calendar_language
methods.description: Provides language-specific labels for months and days based on the language code.
